mapper.sql:
user_roles AS (SELECT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt WHERE gt.subject_type = 'USER' AND gt.subject_id = #{userId} UNION ALL
SELECT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_dept ud ON ud.dept_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' AND ud.user_id = #{userId} AND ud.status = 0 UNION ALL
SELECT gt.role_code FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_post up ON up.post_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.subject_type = 'POST' AND up.user_id = #{userId} AND (up.status IS NULL OR up.status = 0))
mapper.select:
WITH , distinct_roles AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM user_roles ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = ur.role_code WHERE r.status = 0),
distinct_permissions AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM distinct_roles dr JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_code = dr.role_code JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code WHERE p.status = 1)
SELECT 1 AS profile_id, dr.role_code AS role_code, NULL AS permission_code FROM distinct_roles dr UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS profile_id, NULL AS role_code, dp.permission_code AS permission_code FROM distinct_permissions dp

WITH , user_scope_rows AS (SELECT 1 AS source_level, us.scope_type AS scope_type, CAST(us.scope_dept_ids AS CHAR) AS scope_dept_ids, us.policy_code AS policy_code FROM user_scope us WHERE us.user_id = #{userId}), role_scope_rows AS (SELECT 2 AS source_level, rs.scope_type AS scope_type, CAST(rs.scope_dept_ids AS CHAR) AS scope_dept_ids, rs.policy_code AS policy_code FROM role_scope rs JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT role_code FROM user_roles) ur ON ur.role_code = rs.role_code) SELECT usr.source_level, usr.scope_type, usr.scope_dept_ids, usr.policy_code FROM user_scope_rows usr UNION ALL SELECT rsr.source_level, rsr.scope_type, rsr.scope_dept_ids, rsr.policy_code FROM role_scope_rows rsr WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_scope_rows) ORDER BY source_level

WITH , effective_role_policy AS (SELECT rp.role_code, rp.policy_code, rp.priority, rp.condition_override, rp.action_override FROM role_policy rp JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT role_code FROM user_roles) ur ON ur.role_code = rp.role_code WHERE rp.is_deleted = 0 AND (rp.effective_from IS NULL OR rp.effective_from <= NOW()) AND (rp.effective_until IS NULL OR rp.effective_until >= NOW())), effective_policy_definition AS (SELECT pd.policy_code, pd.policy_type, pd.condition_type, pd.condition_expression, pd.action_on_violation, CAST(pd.config AS CHAR) AS config, pd.priority FROM policy_definition pd WHERE pd.is_deleted = 0 AND pd.is_enabled = 1 AND (pd.effective_from IS NULL OR pd.effective_from <= NOW()) AND (pd.effective_until IS NULL OR pd.effective_until >= NOW())) SELECT epd.policy_code, epd.policy_type, COALESCE(erp.action_override, epd.action_on_violation) AS final_action, epd.condition_type, COALESCE(erp.condition_override, epd.condition_expression) AS final_condition_expression, epd.config FROM effective_role_policy erp JOIN effective_policy_definition epd ON epd.policy_code = erp.policy_code ORDER BY erp.priority, epd.priority, epd.policy_code

SELECT DISTINCT gt.subject_id FROM grant_table gt WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'USER' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ud.user_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_dept ud ON ud.dept_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' AND ud.status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT up.user_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_post up ON up.post_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'POST' AND (up.status IS NULL OR up.status = 0)
